0022600031.text: The Timberwolves (6-3, on a two-game win streak and 3rd in the Northwest, 1 game back) visit the Pelicans (4-4, on a four-game win streak and 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup, Minnesota's 10th game of the season. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery; averaging 33.3 points), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while New Orleans is without Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 132-126 win in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
